label: Full pipeline run (steps 1–9), bag from Mandeye raw
source: start_benchmark.sh from the HDMAPPING-CAVE-DATASET-1 orchestration branch (commit 6cb3ceb), algorithms on their Bunker-DVI-Dataset-reg-1 branches; exp1 raw data converted with mandeye_to_rosbag (mandeye-ws_noetic) into reg-1.bag by download_data.sh; ground truth HDMappingGroundTruth/all_tum_files/lio_result_0_trajectory_tum.txt. Step 4 run one algorithm at a time (all sessions at once ran out of memory on 60 GB RAM).
notes: Not evaluated (no usable output): super-lio (NaN poses), ct-icp (27 s of data), loam-livox (all poses zero), slict (no poses), glim (crashed after 9 s), map-lio (crashed at start), d-lio (empty bag), fr-lio and log-lio2 (diverged), c3p-voxelmap and lio-sam (diverged by km; excluded from step 4), lio-ekf (416 GB bag, stopped), pin-slam (out of memory on CPU), nv-liom, kiss-icp, bievr-lio and glass-lio (bag-to-HDMapping converter ran out of memory; recordings kept). Truncated: sr-lio (stops at ~867 s), genz-icp (stops at ~1177 s). hdmapping-lio was stopped during the main run (its chunk cache filled the disk) and re-run on its own on 2026-11-19 with the same input and default parameters; the ground truth also comes from HDMapping (v0.105.0). Step 8 hit its 1800 s time limit for floam, form, i2ekf-lo, lidar_odometry_ros_wrapper, mola, resple, rko-lio, r-voxelmap, superOdom and voxel-map. Step 8 algorithm-to-FARO distances (~2-3 m) and Hausdorff (~100 m) are high for every algorithm, probably because the maps extend beyond the TLS scan (not yet verified); FARO-to-algorithm distance is the more reliable accuracy number.
